listingDescription: About this app arrow_forward Private Eyes helps you hide and protect personal photos, videos and documents from unwanted access in an encrypted vault on your Android phone. CAPTURE DIRECTLY INTO THE VAULT Take photos and record short, silent videos with the optional private camera. Use available focus, exposure, timer and zoom controls. Brief permission prompts and file selection preserve your session; file selection is limited to two minutes. Production screenshots and screen recording are blocked using Android controls. When you choose to export a file, the app warns you that the exported copy will be outside vault protection. Grouped settings explain the available controls and show your current inactivity-lock setting. Optional inactivity locking adds a one- or five-minute timeout. There is no recovery phrase, password reset or cloud backup. Losing your pattern, device or device key can mean permanent loss. Your phone PIN or fingerprint cannot recover a forgotten vault pattern. Do not use the vault as the only copy of irreplaceable files. Imported originals and exported files are outside vault protection. Deletion has no app trash or undo and cannot guarantee physical erasure from flash storage.
